summary: Gorilla Technology Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the dismissal of Marcum Asia CPAs LLP as its independent registered public accounting firm and the appointment of UHY LLP, effective April 30, 2026. The change was approved by the audit committee after a careful evaluation. No disagreements or reportable events occurred during the fiscal years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 or the subsequent interim period. Marcum Asia's audit reports were unqualified. This is a routine auditor change disclosure, not a special situation.
